title: sqliteTableSql
responsibility: Maps model fields to SQLite columns and builds safe identifier and table-definition SQL.

inputs.name: sqliteIdentifier.identifier
inputs.description: An unquoted SQLite identifier that must begin with a letter or underscore and contain only letters, digits or underscores.

inputs.name: sqliteColumn.property
inputs.description: An application property name whose declared column override or snake-case name is requested.

inputs.name: sqliteColumn.field
inputs.description: The field metadata, including an optional explicit database column name.

inputs.name: sqliteTableSql.model
inputs.description: The table, primary-key and field declarations used to form the CREATE TABLE statement.

outputs.name: sqliteIdentifier
outputs.description: The validated identifier wrapped in SQLite double quotes.

outputs.name: sqliteColumn
outputs.description: The explicit database column name or the property name converted to snake case.

outputs.name: sqliteTableSql
outputs.description: A CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statement with mapped column types, nullability, primary-key and timestamp-default clauses.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Raised for an invalid identifier, a missing primary-key field, duplicate column names or an unsupported SQLite field type.
